card.name: Hyphen plus t before tur- words
card.fires_on: The letter t (often after a hyphen) that starts the second part of a hyphenated or joined word, where the next piece is likely to be a tur- or t- syllable such as -turbine, -turvy, -Turkish.

modes.label: Hyphen then t
modes.description: A hyphen plus t joins two word parts, as in compound words and names.
modes.example: The wind<<-t>>urbine farm off of Cape Cod aroused

modes.label: Capital T after hyphen
modes.description: A hyphen plus capital T starts an ethnic or place name part.

modes.label: Other t starts
modes.description: A t or T beginning a word where the model expects a tur-like continuation.

card.writes: It pushes the next piece toward tur-, turb- and turbo- word starts.
card.plain: It fires on a t after a hyphen when the word is likely to continue as turbine, Turkish or similar.
